lead.headline: Trump, Putin and Xi sign 'peace declaration' after historic three-way summit
lead.summary: The first-ever trilateral meeting of the American, Chinese and Russian leaders produced a declaration to cut nuclear risk, keep the Strait of Hormuz open and hold energy supplies steady.

stories.headline: Anthropic raises a record $81.3bn in stock market debut
stories.summary: The first purely AI company to list publicly. Shares opened 34% above their $83 price, valuing it at about $1.76 trillion — even as US stocks fell.

stories.headline: UN court: Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
stories.summary: The International Court of Justice ruled the 2017 crackdown was genocide. The judgment cannot be appealed.

stories.headline: Kyiv hit by ballistic missiles as Crimea bridge is struck again
stories.summary: Four missiles hit the capital, and the bridge to Crimea was attacked for a third time this week.

stories.headline: Tanker ablaze after mine strike near the Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: A tanker caught fire east of the strait as attacks on Gulf shipping widened, with Houthi claims of strikes on four Saudi targets.

stories.headline: India evacuates 80,000 as a cyclone bears down on Odisha
stories.summary: Tens of thousands were moved to shelters as the storm approached India's east coast.
